description: This is a React component implementing a watchlist page allowing CRUD operations with local state and store integration, primarily for managing stock symbols with notes, including sorting, editing, and deletion features.

methods.name: Watchlist
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the watchlist interface with add, edit, delete, and sort functionalities.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Function to trigger re-render by updating internal state version.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new stock symbol to the watchlist, with validation and state updates.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Initiates inline editing mode for a specific symbol.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels inline editing, resetting relevant states.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves changes made during inline editing for a specific symbol.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Prompts user for delete confirmation and deletes the symbol if confirmed.
